svg.title: WhisprLink: Anonymous conversations, on your terms.
svg.desc: Social preview for WhisprLink, an open-source Telegram bot for random chat, anonymous inbox, and private messaging. A large W-shaped symbol with an orange message shape sits beside the wordmark, tagline, and descriptor on a deep charcoal background.

g.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Random Chat · Anonymous Inbox · Private Messaging
